generations.prompt: Photoreal, early morning in a small city café, 35 mm, locked-off camera that does not move. The two women at the table behind, one in a red scarf and one with dark curly hair, are the only people talking: they lean toward each other in a quiet, natural, continuous conversation, their lips moving, one of them laughing briefly. The man behind the counter wipes the counter without speaking. The silver-haired woman in the mustard-yellow raincoat at the window table is completely silent: her lips stay closed and still for the whole shot, she never speaks, mouths words, laughs or hums; she listens with a faint closed-mouth smile, glances once toward the two women, then looks down and draws in her sketchbook, her pencil moving. No new person enters; nothing new appears. No on-screen text, no captions, no lettering anywhere.
